_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description:
Live keeps a paused thought together without moving an answer before its question. The voice call is faked. In an eval, window.liveEmit(event) delivers event from Live (e.g. window.liveEmit({type: "session.input_transcript.delta", delta: "Hello ", start_ms: 0, end_ms: 400})); emit each event in its own eval, in the order given. window.liveSpeak(id, speech) speaks and delegates: it emits {type: "session.input_transcript.delta", delta: speech, start_ms: 0, end_ms: 900} and then {type: "session.delegation.created", offset_ms: 900, delegation: {id, target: "client"}}. window.liveNotes() returns the JSON of everything Shelley sent to Live. window.__voiceTracksStopped counts the microphone tracks stopped. "Start the call" means: click data-testid "live-call-header"; data-testid "live-bar" should contain "On call". "The exchange" is data-testid "live-exchange". "The message X" is the [data-testid="message"] elements whose text contains X (has_text; it collapses whitespace, so a line break is a space). Text checks on messages and the exchange compare whitespace-collapsed text: eval el.textContent.replace(/\s+/g, " ").includes(...) with expect true (or false for "not contain"), on every matching element. "The turns" are the exchange's ".live-exchange-turn" elements; check the nth one with an eval on document.querySelectorAll("[data-testid=live-exchange] .live-exchange-turn")[n]. Perform the steps in order.
1. Navigate to /c/boundaries and start the call.
2. Emit {type: "session.input_transcript.delta", delta: "This is", start_ms: 0, end_ms: 1000}, then {type: "session.output_transcript.delta", delta: "Mm.", start_ms: 900, end_ms: 1200}, then {type: "session.input_transcript.delta", delta: " still one thought", start_ms: 3500, end_ms: 4500}, then {type: "session.input_transcript.delta", delta: "\n.", start_ms: 4500, end_ms: 4500} (a newline and a period). There should be exactly 2 turns, and the first turn's p element should have text exactly "This is still one thought.".
3. Emit {type: "session.output_transcript.delta", delta: "Which panel?", start_ms: 5000, end_ms: 6000}, then {type: "session.input_transcript.delta", delta: "Sidebar.", start_ms: 6200, end_ms: 7000}. There should be exactly 4 turns; the third (index 2) should contain "Which panel?", the fourth (index 3) "Sidebar.", and the first must not contain "Sidebar.".
4. Click data-testid "live-stop".

steps.expression: window.liveEmit({type: 'session.input_transcript.delta', delta: ' still one thought', start_ms: 3500, end_ms: 4500})
